lead_raw_text:
The structure of composition Ag6Sn2Bi2 (reduced formula Ag3SnBi) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 10 atoms per unit cell distributed over 4 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ag centers with 12 geometric neighbors (8 Ag, 2 Bi, 2 Sn) in a close-packed-like local arrangement, while Bi and Sn each have 10 neighbors. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing between Ag 12-vertex polyhedra and between Ag and Sn 10-vertex polyhedra, with a 3-periodic connected component spanning all 10 sites.
